notes: Private fund long/short equity deck (so C3 does not apply) with a gross-only year-to-date callout, a trough-start compounding claim and an undated, unattributed ranking, set against a properly paired gross/net track record and a contributor list shown with the total fund return.

planted.span: In the first half of 2026, the Fund returned 9.4% gross of fees, against 3.1% for the Tennock U.S. Small/Mid Cap Index, with gross exposure held between 140% and 165%.
planted.explanation: The 2026 year-to-date return is given only gross of fees, and no net figure for that period appears anywhere in the deck, let alone with equal prominence.

planted.span: Measured from September 30, 2022, the month-end closest to the market low, through June 30, 2026, the Fund compounded at 14.6% annualized net of fees, turning $1 million into $1.67 million.
planted.explanation: The start date is expressly chosen at the market trough, excluding the 2022 drawdown and producing 14.6% against the 10.9% annualized since inception shown on Slide 5.

planted.span: Named a Top 10 Long/Short Equity Manager by a leading independent hedge fund research service, reflecting the Fund's risk-adjusted returns.
planted.explanation: The ranking omits the date it was given, the period it was based on, the identity of the rater and whether the adviser paid anything to obtain or use it; a reviewer may also read "Top 10" as a C6 statement, but the missing rater disclosures make C7 the primary code.

decoys.why_ok: Every gross figure sits in an adjacent column beside the net figure for the same period in the same format, so net has at least equal prominence.

- Top five detractors: Vintrell Home Furnishings (long, -141), specialty apparel retailer (short, -118), Rushworth Tile & Stone (long, -96), payments processor (short, -88), Kinloss Pet Supply (long, -73).
